task: Sugar Castle: move to the RIGHT of the finish, route the track in a near-full circle around it, remove the backward tilt and the floating foundation
request: Возможно его стоит сделать справа, а не слева от финиша. И объехать его почти кругом, чтобы успеть насладиться. Также сейчас он накренён назад и часть фундамента даже частично висит в воздухе

implementation.loop: CASTLE_COURSE replaces the base-course tail (loopStart 1400 base-metres) with a near-full circle as an isolated Course section, like the cake detour; baseLength unchanged (1473 m). radius 70 m, sweep 5.7 rad (~327 deg), exit straight 55 m to the finish.
implementation.side: castle at the loop centre, on the RIGHT of the approach (loopRight = tangent x UP); constant right-hand turn keeps it inside the loop
implementation.tilt: yaw-only orientation (rotation.y toward the loop entry); rotation.x = rotation.z = 0 (old lookAt(target.y+6) pitched it backwards)
implementation.foundation: castle base at GROUND_Y + 1.4 = -1.95 on the chocolate apron; apron underside on the ground plane GROUND_Y = -3.35 (no floating)
implementation.props: castleKeepOut (radius 53 m) filters scatter props off the royal grounds without disturbing the shared rand() sequence
implementation.balance: track 1865 -> 2247 m (+20%); TIME_MEDAL 105 -> 126 s (cruise auto-drive finishes ~132.6 s); zone 4 Sugar Castle Run widened u0 0.88 -> 0.90; service-worker cache ckc-v63

checks.castleqa: 2 GLB castles, 41510 tris / 11 calls each, COLOR_0 + UV + vertexColors, no fallback warnings, no page errors
